inputs.name: createDeploymentActivityStore.workspace
inputs.description: The Workspace value captured by the store supplies projectId for deciding whether a finished activity belongs to the current project. When a received activity for that project has a truthy finishedAt different from its previously stored value, the store calls optional deployments.refresh().

outputs.name: createDeploymentActivityStore
outputs.description: A DeploymentActivityState instance bound to the supplied Workspace, with items initially [] and error initially ''. It exposes activeCount, which counts items without a truthy finishedAt, plus remember(job) and watch(); the watcher covers desktop deployments independently of the project being browsed.
